question: Which of the following sportspersons was one of the India's flagbearers for the Paris 2024 Olympics?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**A Sharath Kamal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Sharath Kamal** is a prominent **Indian table tennis player**.
 
• He has been a significant contributor to Indian table tennis for many years.
 
• Sharath Kamal has won multiple **Commonwealth Games medals**, including **gold medals** in both singles and team events.
 
• He has also represented India in several **Asian Games** and **Olympic Games**.
 
• Sharath Kamal's dedication and success have made him a leading figure in Indian sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vinesh Phogat**__

 __
 
• **Vinesh Phogat** is an Indian wrestler who has won medals in various **international wrestling competitions**.
 
• She has secured gold medals in the **Commonwealth Games** and the **Asian Games**.
 
• Vinesh is part of the famous Phogat family, known for producing several successful Indian wrestlers.
 
 
 
• **MC Mary Kom**__
 __
 
• **MC Mary Kom** is a celebrated Indian boxer who has won multiple **world championships**.
 
• She has also secured a **bronze medal** at the **2012 London Olympics**.
 
• Mary Kom is widely regarded as one of the greatest female boxers in history.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**__
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian javelin thrower who won the **gold medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• He is the first Indian athlete to win an Olympic gold in track and field events.
 
• Neeraj Chopra has set several national records in javelin throw.
